title: rpl_stack invalid-version-option DIO test never reaches the validation it targets
description: Codereview finding (pass 3, edge-cases) from worker6-8rm3 verification round. rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1096-1119 (inside multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received) sends 5 malformed-version-option DIOs ([], [0x13,0], [0x13,2,3,0], duplicate, [0x13,1,2]) built by dio_packet_with_raw_version_options(root_addr, ...) with a NATIVE 02xx source (root_address) and via the compressing Stack::send_ipv6_to. Production DIOs use link-local fe80:: source over Rule 255. The packets are therefore rejected at dio_dis_destination_is_allowed (receive.rs:323-324; util.rs:207-209 requires fe80::/10 source) BEFORE process_rpl -> process_authenticated_dio -> parse_authenticated_dio_evidence — the version-option validation at lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:1969-1987 (MalformedRuleVersionLength0/Length2/Duplicate/Missing) is never exercised end-to-end. The test is green for the wrong reason: deleting the codec option checks would keep it green. (Codec-level variants are covered by lichen-schc/tests/authenticated_dio_vectors.rs; the gap is the rpl_stack pipeline coverage.) Fix is NOT just source+transport swap: reaching the codec gate means rejection fires revoke_schc_peer (router.rs:420), evicting the root as leaf's parent — so assertions must change to expect the eviction then verify recovery via the next canonical send_dio, OR the revoke-on-malformed-option semantics must be redesign-reviewed (fail-closed vs option-malformed-is-not-adversarial). That semantics call belongs to the worker-6 thread. Discovered-from: project-LICHEN-worker6-8rm3
